publication.policy: Publication candidates are review-only until an explicit, path-selective launch decision. A global flag without an allowlist emits no sitemap URLs.

canonical.policy: Canonical identity is checked against the exact public path by the production identity collector; source inventory does not assert live parity.

indexability.policy: Indexability is host- and exact-path-gated. hotel_tours remain noindex,follow and outside the sitemap in the production identity contract.

sitemap.policy: Generated Egypt/Maldives resort routes are materializer-gated and must be proven by the live production collector rather than inferred from this static snapshot.

internal_links.policy: Only curated stable first-party paths are eligible; query, fragment and external URLs are rejected from editorial link groups.

schema.policy: Schema helpers are constrained to clean AnyTour URLs and escaped JSON-LD. This baseline does not claim visible-content parity for each public page family.

performance.policy: The V2 startup bundle contract verifies deterministic versions, immutable cache headers and two startup bundle requests. No page-family Core Web Vitals result is claimed by this source baseline.

guarantees: The inventory references only tracked source owners.
The static sitemap counts and exclusions remain reproducible from v2/sitemap.xml.
The artifact cannot be represented as a live, traffic, conversion or ranking report.
The foundation slice has no V2 runtime file changes.
